_about: ElevenLabs voices for the intro and the take used for every line (one take each). tools/import_voices.py turns the downloaded takes into audio/ and js/voice.js. Flow: https://elevenlabs.io/app/flows/zcCV1suBjHLlcu4BQkWK

open.ahem.prompt: [sheepishly] [strong Italian accent] Ahem. My cousins. They get a little excited.

intro.1.prompt: [happy] [strong Italian accent] Welcome to /ˈlɪŋ.ɡwae̯/! That's Latin for languages.

intro.2.prompt: [happy] [strong Italian accent] Here, you practice a language the way you'll actually use it: one whole sentence at a time.

intro.3.prompt: [happy] [strong Italian accent] Every language gets its own site, and every site gets its own tutor.

intro.4.prompt: [happy] [strong Italian accent] There's me, for Latin.

intro.6.prompt: [curious] [strong French accent] Bonjour! Félicien, for French.

intro.7.prompt: [happy] [strong German accent] Hallo! Fröhlix, for German.

intro.8.prompt: [happy] [strong Italian accent] And you only need one account. Make it once, and it works on every site.

ask.lang.prompt: [curious] [strong Italian accent] So, which language are you learning?

hand.la.prompt: [excited] [strong Italian accent] Latin? /ˈop.ti.meː/! That's my specialty. [happy] Let me show you around /ˈwer.ba/.

hand.es.prompt: [happy] [strong Italian accent] Spanish? Then you want my cousin. Felicísimo!

hand.fr.prompt: [happy] [strong Italian accent] French? Félicien, you're up!

hand.de.prompt: [happy] [strong Italian accent] German? Fröhlix, over to you!

la.1.prompt: [happy] [strong Italian accent] /ˈwer.ba/ is where you practice Latin, from Latin One Honors all the way to AP Latin.

la.2.prompt: [happy] [strong Italian accent] Start by picking your topics. They're sorted by class, and the ones you've already covered in class are shaded. Press Focus on a topic to practice it in every sentence.

la.3.prompt: [happy] [strong Italian accent] Then I build you a brand-new sentence, and you translate the whole thing: English to Latin, or Latin to English.

la.4.prompt: [happy] [strong Italian accent] I check your answer and show you exactly what went wrong. Word order that doesn't change the meaning never counts against you, and a missing macron still counts, unless it changes the word.

la.5.prompt: [happy] [strong Italian accent] After a translation, name why one word is used for extra credit. There's a whole mode for that, too.

la.6.prompt: [curious] [strong Italian accent] Stuck? Ask me anything. Before you answer, I won't give it away. After you answer, ask whatever you like.

la.7.prompt: [happy] [strong Italian accent] To power me, you'll need a free AI key. The site's guide walks you through getting one in a couple of minutes.

la.8.prompt: [happy] [strong Italian accent] Ending charts and vocabulary sit right above every sentence, and you can hide them whenever you want.

la.9.prompt: [excited] [strong Italian accent] Every right answer earns XP. Climb from /dɪsˈkɪ.pʊ.lʊs/ to /ɪm.pɛˈraː.tɔr/, keep your daily streak going, and finish AP Latin to earn the /ˈlau̯.rɛ.a/.

la.10.prompt: [happy] [strong Italian accent] Make an account to keep your progress on any device and to join the leaderboard. No email needed. Just keep your account key somewhere safe, because a forgotten password can't be recovered.

ask.la.prompt: [curious] [strong Italian accent] Ready? Shall we head to /ˈwer.ba/?
